excludedSourceRows.sourceIssueReference: During the absolute peak of X-Men comic book sales popularity, an all-new Xtreme tactical strike team named X-Force was born. While initially and frequently fronted by Cable, the X-Force tag has covered a variety of X-teams throughout the years, tackling mutant problems too dirty or violent for the X-Men.
Below you’ll find a complete guide to X-Force comics throughout Marvel history, from the early 90’s through present day.
Blank source marker at source position 8
Material From New War – Riors Annual 1
Spiraling out of X-Tinction Agenda, Rob Liefeld and Fabian Nicieza grow Cable in to the action packed military strategist we’ve come to know today.
X-Cutioner’s Song is the definitive 90’s Cable event, diving deep into his connections to Cyclops, Jean Grey, Stryfe, and good old Apocalypse.
X-Force , X-Statix, and Back Again in the 2000’s
Blank source marker at source position 138
Technically this continues the X-Force series, despite the vast differences in approach and eventual change where the comic was retitled X-Statix after issue #129.
“The Legend Returns” by Rob Liefeld and Fabian Nicieza
X-Force Doing the Jobs The X-Men Can’t
Collects: Messiah Complex event reading order.
Blank source marker at source position 286
Cable forms a new X-Force in Marvel NOW, with old favorites like Domino and new X-Men associates like Hope and Dr. Nemesis.
Cable and X-Force Volume 2: Dead or Alive
Cable and X-Force Volume 3: This Won’t End Well

proposedManifest.name: X-Force
proposedManifest.description: X-Force from its early Cable-led missions through later team eras and Uncanny X-Force.
proposedManifest.sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide

candidateMetadata.title: Cable (1993) #5
candidateMetadata.description: Revenge, thy name is SINSEAR! The mechanized killer from the future is out for blood, and he has Cable squarely in his sights! Can Nate survive the gauntlet of death that Sinsear has thrown him into? And what exactly is the reason for the cyborg's thirst for vengeance?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable (1993) #6
candidateMetadata.description: The identity of the enigmatic Mr. Tolliver- revealed! A Sinister rendezvous leads to the return of a deadly foe! And Cable faces a twofold ambush- of his body AND mind!

candidateMetadata.title: Cable (1993) #7
candidateMetadata.description: STRYFE LIVES! With the body of Nathan Summers under his control, Stryfe begins his assault on Cable's life and friends! Only one hope remains for Cable- his parents, Cyclops and Jean Grey of the X-Men! And Cable's wayward son Tyler learns the truth of his father's origin- but can he survive Stryfe's ambush?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable (1993) #8
candidateMetadata.description: It's a Summers family reunion! Cyclops, Jean Grey, Professor X, and Cable's son Tyler face off against the resurrected Stryfe- in control of Cable's body! Can these telepathic titans save Cable from Stryfe's control...or will Cable have to pay the ultimate price for him to be stopped?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #32
candidateMetadata.description: While the rest of the team are desperate to find them- Sam, Boomer, and Magma are stuck in a sick and twisted game by the Gamemaster. Will X-Force interrogating the Guthrie family be enough to save their teammates?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #116
candidateMetadata.description: The perils of fame and fortune have wrapped its deadly grip around X-Force! But when the team (finally) decides to do something heroic, their inflated egos get the best of them!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #117
candidateMetadata.description: Scandal continues to surround X-Force when new and old members are shuffled around and go head to head! Meanwhile U-Go Girl throws a tantrum over the announcement of the team's new leader.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #118
candidateMetadata.description: X-Force travels to Bastrona to rescue Paco Perez, a mutant hostage!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #119
candidateMetadata.description: X-Force saves Paco- but the Coach has bigger plans in mind for the youngster. Can Guy Smith protect the boy while protecting his own neck?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #120
candidateMetadata.description: Coach's master plan is revealed! Guest-starring Wolverine!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #121
candidateMetadata.description: Media frenzy breaks out when the mutant Spike claims he was not welcomed to join X-Force because of their being racist. This is much to the satisfaction of team owner Freeman, who has a few more PR stunts up his sleeve!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #122
candidateMetadata.description: The team goes absolutely haywire on live television as Edie hosts a trial run of her own talk show!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #124
candidateMetadata.description: Edie makes up with her family and Guy in order to restore control over her powers.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #125
candidateMetadata.description: Agent Wright of the CIA reveals that pharmaceutical companies are out for vengeance against Guy!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #126
candidateMetadata.description: Dead Girl's backstory is revealed!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #127
candidateMetadata.description: A mission does not go according to plan when members of X-Force fail to follow the plan set in motion by the CIA.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #128
candidateMetadata.description: The team's relief and happiness is short-lived when they discover that an imposter is in their midst. One ignorant mistake will cost them dearly.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (1991) #129
candidateMetadata.description: Honoring the memory of Edie, Guy reveals the team's new name on Lacuna's talk show. X-STATIX is born!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #1
candidateMetadata.description: X-Statix is thrown on the public's backburner when O-Force is introduced - an interactive mutant team where the public controls the team roster! Will the media hype cast a shadow over the unveiling of X-Statix's newest addition, Venus Dee Milo?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #2
candidateMetadata.description: Personal issues cause tension within the team, causing major drama between members. Meanwhile, a visit from a rival's lawyer could spell disaster for Venus.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #3
candidateMetadata.description: The team has split and gone its separate ways, despite Guy Smith's honest effort to keep them together! After a shocking discovery, can Mister Sensitive enter the battle as a solo act?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #4
candidateMetadata.description: With Venus free from her contract and Vivisector and Phat's relationship in the open, the team is back and better than ever! Their first mission- save the Orphan from Arnie Lunt!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #5
candidateMetadata.description: In an attempt to create good PR for Arnie, now known as the Mysterious Fan Boy, Guy and Lacuna take him on a mission in the Bayou.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #6
candidateMetadata.description: When new villain BAD GUY emerges to take down the missing Guy Smith, X-Statix knows they are no match! Unaware of the villain's true identity, will the team be fighting their former leader, or an unknown imposter?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #7
candidateMetadata.description: In the thick of battle, Venus teleports herself and Bad Guy to her cabin, convinced that he is actually Guy Smith! But what if Venus is wrong?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #8
candidateMetadata.description: The real Guy is back! Meanwhile, Venus must face her past before taking down the mysterious creature that has been haunting her.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #9
candidateMetadata.description: Your inside peek at the making of the X-Statix movie! But there's trouble on set when Sharon Ginsberg goes berserk!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #10
candidateMetadata.description: While going through Edie's old diaries, Venus learns of U-Go Girl's origins and history with X-Force.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #11
candidateMetadata.description: X-Statix welcomes its newest member- El Guapo! Can the skateboard-wielding recruit handle the pressures of fame?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #12
candidateMetadata.description: After discovering the sick fetish of the X-Statix's head mortician, Dead Girl gets her own revenge- not once, but twice. You only die once, right?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #13
candidateMetadata.description: Henrietta Hunter, the European pop star who was long thought to be dead, has been resurrected with the help of her mutant powers! Guest-starring the Amazing Spider-Man!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #14
candidateMetadata.description: X-Statix's efforts in rescuing Henrietta are in vain when they discover her secret intentions.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #15
candidateMetadata.description: Henrietta decides that X-Statix is the only solution to the random killings happening throughout the country.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Statix (2002) #16
candidateMetadata.description: Lacuna receives some juicy intel for her show- Spike and former X-Forcer, Edie Sawyer, helped sell chemical weapons to Saddam Hussein!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Men: The Times and Life of Lucas Bishop (2009) #1
candidateMetadata.seriesName: X-Men: The Times and Life of Lucas Bishop (2009 - Present)

candidateMetadata.title: X-Men: The Times and Life of Lucas Bishop (2009) #2
candidateMetadata.seriesName: X-Men: The Times and Life of Lucas Bishop (2009 - Present)

candidateMetadata.title: X-Men: The Times and Life of Lucas Bishop (2009) #3
candidateMetadata.seriesName: X-Men: The Times and Life of Lucas Bishop (2009 - Present)

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2008) #23
candidateMetadata.description: NECROSHA CHAPTER 4 X-Force has a new mission: kill Selene. As Utopia burns, Wolverine and the team head to take down the Black Queen and rescue one of their own, but they have no idea what they're in for when they arrive on the shores of Necrosha.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2008) #24
candidateMetadata.description: NECROSHA CHAPTER FIVE Death comes to X-Force! The final battle begins as X-Force storms Necrosha to find and kill the Black Queen...but there are 16 million of her slaves between them and her.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2008) #25
candidateMetadata.description: NECROSHA CONCLUSION Everything Destiny foretold has come true. The Black Queen has become the Dark Goddess, but X-Force's mission stands...kill her! But how do you fight a god with claws, knives and guns?

candidateMetadata.title: X Necrosha: The Gathering (2009) #1
candidateMetadata.description: Selene's Inner Circle stand revealed: Wither, Mortis, Senyaka, Eli Bard and Blink. But what led Selene to gather some of the deadliest mutants in the world? Why would one of the X-Men's students join her? Who is Mortis? How is Blink alive?

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #2
candidateMetadata.description: BISHOP VS. UNCANNY X-FORCE. What secrets does the man with the "M" on his face bring from the future?

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #20
candidateMetadata.description: THE TRIAL OF FANTOMEX PART 1 The X-Force team journey to Otherworld! Guest starring Captain Britain and the Captain Britain Corps!

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #21
candidateMetadata.description: Wolverine and AOA Nightcrawler face a strange and deadly new foe in Otherworld. Plus, Fantomex's sentence is carried out and he is injected with an anti-reality serum. And Psylocke becomes Lady Briton!

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #22
candidateMetadata.description: Wolverine and AOA Nightcrawler face a strange and deadly new foe in Otherworld. Meanwhile, Fantomex's sentence is carried out and he is injected with an anti-reality serum. Plus, Psylocke becomes Lady Briton!

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #23
candidateMetadata.description: The trial of Fantomex concludes! The multiverse is in danger, the Captain Britain Corps is in shambles and it is up to X-Force to save the day. A terrible choice must be made for the protection of all reality!

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #25
candidateMetadata.description: THE FINAL EXECUTION PART 1 The battle between the Omegas and X-Force begin! Who is this Omega team and what is their grudge with X-Force?

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #26
candidateMetadata.description: X-FORCE is put to the test when a powered group named the OMEGAS battle some of the team's strongest members! Meanwhile, Psylocke goes to the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning to visit an old friend, but what she finds may shock her to the core!

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #31
candidateMetadata.description: The FINAL EXECUTION kicks into high gear. What is left of X-Force go up against the new Brotherhood of Evil Mutants for the last time.

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #32
candidateMetadata.description: FINAL EXECUTION nears its brutal finish! The X-Force finally faces off against the new Brotherhood of Evil Mutants all at once!

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #33
candidateMetadata.description: FINAL EXECUTION races to its thrilling conclusion! X-Force brings the attack to the Brotherhood, but there is dissension in the ranks.

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #34
candidateMetadata.description: Genesis faces the truth about Apocalypse and his destiny!

candidateMetadata.title: Uncanny X-Force (2010) #35
candidateMetadata.description: FINAL EXTINCTION CONCLUDES AND SO DOES UNCANNY X-FORCE! Rick Remender's landmark run comes to a conclusion with one of the most shocking moments in X-Force history. What will become of what's left of X-Force?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #1
candidateMetadata.description: Marvel NOW! Caught red-handed at the scene of a terrorist attack on a major American corporation whose CEO has expressed anti-mutant views, the X-Force is the run, with none other than the Uncanny Avengers in hot pursuit.

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #2
candidateMetadata.description: Cable is back! NOW! with a new X-Force at his side, he must tackle the threats that nobody else can know about. But just who are Cable's new recruits, and why is his team public enemy number one? Caught red-handed at the scene of a terrorist attack on a major American corporation whose CEO has expressed anti-mutant views, the X-Force is the run, with none other than the Uncanny Avengers in hot pursuit.

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #3
candidateMetadata.description: What has Colossus been up to post-AVX? What is wrong with his powers? And why are Cable and his team attacking a civilian company?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #4
candidateMetadata.description: Witness the massacre that makes Cable and X-Force criminals. They can't go back from here...

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #5
candidateMetadata.description: X-FORCE is officially on the run. Cable must face his daughter Hope, the savior of AVX. The Uncanny Avengers are hot on their trail!

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #6
candidateMetadata.description: A new arc begins! Great jumping on point! Cable's team loses a member as Colossus goes to jail.

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #7
candidateMetadata.description: Cyclops comes face-to-face with his son Cable. Colossus isn't faring well in prison.

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #8
candidateMetadata.description: Cable and his team go into space facing down an armada! Will this put them face-to-face with the UNCANNY AVENGERS, who are still hot in pursuit?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #9
candidateMetadata.description: Guest starring the Uncanny Avengers! Hope goes on the run, determined to help Cable whether he wants it or not...but the Uncanny Avengers have been keeping tabs on Hope and they're not about to let her get tangled up with Cable's band of fugitives!

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #10
candidateMetadata.description: Guest starring the Uncanny Avengers! Hope goes on the run, determined to help Cable whether he wants it or not...but the Uncanny Avengers have been keeping tabs on Hope and they're not about to let her get tangled up with Cable's band of fugitives!

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #11
candidateMetadata.description: As tensions rise between X-Force and the Uncanny Avengers, Cable's precognitive visions grow increasingly relentless. X-Force must race against the clock to stop each terrible vision from coming true - but what will happen if they fail? In the world of X-Force, a minute can mean the difference between life and death.

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #12
candidateMetadata.description: Domino and Colossus team up for the heist of the century! But will their mounting feelings for one another keep them from pulling of their mission?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #13
candidateMetadata.description: It's a Summers Family Reunion when Cable and Havok come face to face! Can Cable convince his uncle that his cause is just? Elsewhere, Hope embarks upon a futuristic adventure - with an unexpected mentor!

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #14
candidateMetadata.description: It's time for the final showdown: X-FORCE vs. THE UNCANNY AVENGERS! Can Hope save her adopted father from the Uncanny Avengers - and from himself? And in the wake of this tumultuous battle, what will be the future of Cable's X-Force?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #15
candidateMetadata.description: Father and daughter are reunited as Cable's and Hope's separate missions converge! Cable has finally solved one of his most vexing problems - but a dozen more are still on the horizon! There's no rest for the weary as Hope, Cable, and the rest of X-Force converge to tackle an ominous new threat!

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #16
candidateMetadata.description: In the aftermath of X-Force's battle with the Uncanny Avengers, Cable's mutant powers have been drastically altered. What will this mean when the next cataclysmic threat comes knocking at X-Force's door?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #17
candidateMetadata.description: In the thrall of the Adversary, what havoc will Forge unleash upon Cable and X-Force? And in the wake of the devastation, can Cable come to terms with his drastically altered powers in time to save his daughter?

candidateMetadata.title: Cable and X-Force (2012) #18
candidateMetadata.description: "VENDETTA" Four Part X-FORCE Event! Issue #18 - "VENDETTA" PART I. Issue #19 - "VENDETTA" PART III. Classic X-Force villain STRYFE has returned! And he's eager to exact his revenge on the man who left him broken and adrift in the timestream: CABLE. As Stryfe's plan comes to bear, Hope is brought face-to-face with Bishop, the man who crusaded across centuries in a mission to exterminate her. But this time around, she's ready to retaliate--and they'll hold nothing back as they race to destroy one another. Don't miss this no-holds-barred, knockdown, drag-out X-FORCE event! Because when the dust settles, only ONE X-Force team will be left standing.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #1
candidateMetadata.description: Almost every sovereign state in the Marvel Universe makes use of sanctioned superhumans to protect national interests and pursue a covert agenda. The United States has the Secret Avengers. The United Kingdom has MI13. And mutantkind has X-FORCE. In this dirty, secret, no-holds-barred, deadly game of superhuman black ops, veteran X-Man Cable and his team will spy, torture, and kill to ensure that the mutant race not only has a place in the world…but also a stake in it.

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #2
candidateMetadata.description: Cable. Psylocke. Fantomex. Marrow. They are mutantkind's protectors, spies, assassins and torturers! But just what has driven each of them to join the most deadly incarnation of X-FORCE yet? Yes, Marrow is back! But how has she regained her mutant powers and what does it have to do with X-Force's first target?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #3
candidateMetadata.description: X-Force races their foe, ruthless arms-dealer Volga, through the jungles of Brazil to locate a mutant who might be the key to his undoing. But can Psylocke curb her bloodlust long enough to complete the mission? And a new member is introduced to the team!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #4
candidateMetadata.description: X-Force goes head to head with France's superhuman black ops team! But will X-Force's resident Frenchman Fantomex botch his teammates' mission?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #5
candidateMetadata.description: X-Force comes face-to-face with Volga, the mastermind who's been weaponizing superhumans and using them in the undercover war that's being waged across the globe. But little does X-Force know that Volga has already weaponized one of their own?And by the time this issue is through, one member of X-Force will meet their end!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #6
candidateMetadata.description: The explosive conclusion of the first arc of X-FORCE! The unthinkable has occurred! One of the team is dead and the others are held captive by their newest foe: the swaggering oligarch VOLGA. Struggling to save their own lives, X-Force's secrets come to light as they use everything in their arsenal to survive. But when the dust settles, will these revealed truths ultimately tear them apart?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #7
candidateMetadata.description: X-Force has barely survived an encounter with their newest foe-the swaggering superhuman arms dealer VOLGA?and with their secrets brought to light, they're barely surviving EACH OTHER. How will Cable's team keep it together to carry out their mission? Well I can tell you part of the answer: DOMINO is back! But she could just be in over her head already?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #8
candidateMetadata.description: Every country employs covert superhumans to protect their interests. And while pursuing the foe who killed one of their own, X-Force is about to run afoul of the United Kingdom's superhuman operatives: PETE WISDOM and MI13! In this game of spy versus spy, how can X-Force manage to outplay the best spy there is?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #9
candidateMetadata.description: In the deserts of Afghanistan, X-Force has found a lead that could help them track down the villain who killed one of their own. But standing in their way is Britain?s own team of superhuman operatives: MI13! As the two factions come to blows, little do they know that a third player threatens to wipe them all off the board?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #10
candidateMetadata.description: X-Force has their sights set on their next target, a mutant who may just hold the key to defeating their greatest adversary: X-MEN: LEGACY #300?s ForgetMeNot! But how can they convince him to join their cause? And more importantly: How can they hope to find a mutant who slips out of memory whenever he leaves their sight?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Men Legacy (2012) #300
candidateMetadata.description: In observance of the title's 300th issue, iconic X-MEN: LEGACY writers Mike Carey, Christos Gage and Simon Spurrier return to tell an all-new tale of the X-Men! Mike Carey brings us a story featuring Professor Xavi - oh wait, he's dead. Well, Christos Gage has penned a tale involving Rog - nope. She's dead too. And Simon! There's Simon Spurrier with a story led by Legion, who - oops. Can't spoil the ending of X-MEN: LEGACY #24. Well...erm...just read it!

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #11
candidateMetadata.description: X-Force has their sights set on their next target, a mutant who may just hold the key to defeating their greatest adversary: X-MEN: LEGACY #300?s ForgetMeNot! But how can they convince him to join their cause? And more importantly: How can they hope to find a mutant who slips out of memory whenever he leaves their sight?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #12
candidateMetadata.description: "ENDS/MEANS" Part 2 of 5! Fantomex's compulsion to be THE BEST has put him at odds with X-Force! Turning on his former teammates, can a squad of killers hope to escape science''s perfect living weapon? Also! The true identity of the villain X-Force has been pursuing is revealed...and it's an all-too familiar face...

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #13
candidateMetadata.description: The fate of Hope Summers revealed! Fantomex takes on each and every one of the world's secret intelligence agencies! And on the outs with the rest of his team, Cable hatches one last scheme?

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #14
candidateMetadata.description: Fantomex is on a murderous rampage, taking out each and every one of the world's secret intelligence agencies, working his way closer to getting revenge on X-Force! Knowing the confrontation is inevitable, Cable and his team ready themselves for the fight of their lives…

candidateMetadata.title: X-Force (2014) #15
candidateMetadata.description: THIS IS IT! In the final showdown with Fantomex, X-Force gives everything they have to defeat their power-mad teammate-turned-adversary! And in the end, not everyone will emerge unscathed?
